steps.player: Do you know how many lizardmen I've killed?

historical-dialogue.npc: Quiet! I'm here observing the lizardmen shamans, try not to blow my cover.

historical-dialogue.player: You don't seem to be hiding very well.

historical-dialogue.npc: As if you could do better!

historical-dialogue.player: Riiiight, anyways, can I attack these lizardmen shaman?

historical-dialogue.text: If the player has less than 100% Shayzien favour:

steps.npc: Absolutely not! Do you want to get me killed? Now get out of here and stop trying to blow my cover!

historical-dialogue.text: If the player has 100% Shayzien favour:

steps.npc: Well I don't like the idea of you risking my cover. You are trusted by the Shayzien people though, so I suppose you can. Just be careful.
